question: In humoral responses dependent on T lymphocytes:

options.opa: B lymphocytes express CD40L on the surface.
options.opb: Activated B lymphocytes migrate to the follicle following a gradient of IL-2.
options.opc: The antigen is taken up by B lymphocytes and presented to the Tγδ lymphocytes.
options.opd: The B lymphocytes process and present the antigen, alter its profile of chemokine receptors and migrate to the area of ​​the T lymphocytes.
